meaning: Classification and convergence obligations, not a claim that the original catalog has been ported. Every future mechanism must enter a reviewed family; individual skill IDs are never renderer dispatch keys.

identity.coverage: Names, tags and material colors join shared profiles. Retain provenance; reconcile prior five damage colors with the current nine Thread definitions through content.

catalog_rules.coverage: Acquisition, eligibility and numeric tuning use existing UI; a cosmetic cast cue must not pretend a stat or drop rule is a visible hit.

cast_lifecycle.coverage: Current active casts share confirmed lifecycle identity and authoritative readiness, emission and channel-beat clocks in both clients. Thread templates and composed layers are implemented. Original unported cast mechanics, staged timing glyphs and mode-specific progress artwork remain migration work; readiness and beat deadlines never imply release.

resolved_contact.coverage: Confirmed positive damage, block and evade select distinct shared outcomes. Correlated damage keeps the originating cast ID; uncorrelated contact uses a target outcome with no invented cast. Original attack silhouettes remain in delivery/voice obligations.

restoration.coverage: Positive Healed and revival transitions use inward mend and opening revival cues. Resource type remains tagged. Resource-transfer paths that do not publish Healed still need an adapter; original beam/link effects remain pending.

status_transitions.coverage: Status application/expiry use shared transitions; beneficial application is distinct from harmful application. Persistent defense plates, state intensity, stacking and transfer links need durable state bindings and both renderers before parity can be claimed.

delivery_and_forecast.coverage: Authoritative projectile/field entities carry world state. Supported area roots share resolved candidate geometry, committed/live aim policy, modifiers and conditional height/LOS semantics between combat and both clients. Unknown delivery graphs remain spatially unavailable. Swept travel, secondary placements, dependent wrappers, surface clipping and authored attack voices remain shared-family work. Cosmetic rings are never hit bounds.

spatial_movement.coverage: Transforms are authoritative and shared. Original trails, departure/arrival distinctions, grab/throw relationships and body-deformation visuals need reusable movement/state adapters, not skill-specific draw paths.

companions_and_constructs.coverage: Summoned/deployed actors use ordinary authoritative entities; compiled minion capability adds a shared release accent. Birth, command, possession, stance, formation and construct-specific artwork remain shared actor/state obligations.

effect_composition.coverage: Existing context propagation preserves originating identity through executed nested/delayed/projectile work. Supports contribute compiled tags/mechanisms without an ID switch. Prototype-specific trigger/sequel/tree behavior must be ported before its semantics can be certified; child hits must come from executed outcomes.

durable_defense_and_resources.coverage: Port the original shared defense/state vocabulary: plates, spiral, carapace, brace, guard, stored charge and discharge. Needs replicated durable state, source provenance and paired renderers; a cast sparkle is not coverage for this family.

authored_effect_voices.coverage: These eight are only the registrations in the original base effectVoice module. Additional modules can register more. Preserve the original assets/profile parameters when a shared primitive or sprite adapter is added; current simple geometry is not their visual parity.
